papers.title: Technology Shocks, Relative Performance Measures, and Outcomes: Evidence from Classical Chess
papers.abstract: In the fall of 2020, neural-network methods produced a large improvement in chess engines that became freely and widely available. By the end of 2021, the monthly draw rate in classical chess had risen by about four percentage points, but the distribution of player ratings, which are commonly read as measures of playing strength, had changed little. Ratings, however, are a relative measure, built from results against other rated players rather than from an absolute scale of play quality, so an improvement shared broadly across players need not change their ratings. Using 3.9 million rated classical games from March 2015 to November 2023, we document that the increased draw rate remains after conditioning on both players' ratings, holds within repeated same-color matchups, is not a continuation of a pre-existing trend, and persists through the end of the sample. A linear transformation that maps post-Covid ratings to higher pre-Covid equivalents, with a larger gap at lower ratings, accounts for more than 90 percent of the post-minus-pre shift in the fitted draw, White-win, and Black-win probabilities. Players' ratings and ranks, by contrast, show no additional rank reshuffling and no general widening of within-group dispersion relative to the pre-Covid benchmark. We interpret these findings as consistent with adoption across rating levels, with larger rating-equivalent gains for lower-rated players.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】2020年秋季，神经网络技术在象棋引擎方面取得了显著进步，这些改进成果被免费且广泛地应用于实际游戏中。到2021年底，经典象棋中的平局率上升了约4个百分点，但棋手等级的分布（通常被视为衡量棋手实力的指标）几乎没有变化。然而，棋手等级是一种相对性的评估方式，它是根据棋手与其他等级棋手的对弈结果来确定的，而非基于绝对的棋艺水平。因此，即使所有棋手的水平都得到了提升，他们的等级也可能不会发生变化。通过对2015年3月至2023年11月期间共计390万场经典象棋对局的数据分析，我们发现：在控制了双方棋手等级因素后，平局率依然存在；这种现象在相同颜色的棋手之间的对弈中同样显著；它并非某种先前趋势的延续，并且在整个数据样本期间都持续存在。通过一种线性转换方法，将新冠疫情后的棋手等级映射到新冠疫情前的对应等级，可以解释平局率、白方胜率和黑方胜率变化中的90%以上。相比之下，棋手的等级和排名并未出现额外的重新排序，也没有出现相对于新冠疫情前基准情况而言的组内分散度增加的现象。我们认为这些发现表明，这种技术进步在各个等级段的棋手中都得到了普及，尤其是对于等级较低的棋手来说，他们的等级提升更为明显。。

papers.title: Prediction-Powered Causal Inference by Automatic Debiased Machine Learning and Semi-Supervised Riesz Regression
papers.abstract: This study investigates semiparametric efficient estimation of causal and structural parameters in a semi-supervised setting. In our setting, unlabeled auxiliary regressors are available in addition to labeled observations consisting of outcomes and regressors. Our goal is to construct estimators of causal and structural parameters whose asymptotic variances are smaller than those of estimators constructed using only labeled data. We refer to this framework as prediction-powered causal inference (PPCI). We first derive the efficient influence function and the efficiency bound, which imply that the use of auxiliary regressors can attain a smaller asymptotic variance than the efficiency bound attainable from labeled observations alone. Then, by combining the efficient influence function with the debiased machine learning (DML) framework, we propose methods that we call DML-PPCI. If we construct an estimating-equation estimator, we refer to the method as EE-DML-PPCI; if we construct a targeted-learning estimator, we refer to the method as TMLE-DML-PPCI. The asymptotic variances of both estimators match our derived efficiency bound. In the construction of the estimators, estimation of the efficient influence function plays an important role. In our study, the efficient influence function is also a Neyman orthogonal score, which depends on the Riesz representer and the regression function. For Riesz representer estimation, we develop semi-supervised generalized Riesz regression with convergence rate guarantees.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】本研究探讨了在半监督环境下对因果参数和结构参数进行半参数高效估计的方法。在我们的研究框架中，除了包含结果变量和回归变量的标记观测数据外，还存在着未标记的辅助回归变量。我们的目标是构建这样的估计量：其渐近方差小于仅使用标记数据构建的估计量的渐近方差。我们将这种方法称为“基于预测的因果推断”（Prediction-Powered Causal Inference，简称PPCI）。首先，我们推导出了高效影响函数（efficient influence function）及其效率界限（efficiency bound），这些结果表明利用辅助回归变量能够实现比仅依赖标记观测数据更小的渐近方差。随后，通过将高效影响函数与去偏机器学习（debiased machine learning，简称DML）框架相结合，我们提出了两种新的估计方法，分别命名为DML-PPCI和TMLE-DML-PPCI。其中，如果构建的是基于估计方程的估计量，则称为EE-DML-PPCI；如果构建的是基于目标学习的估计量，则称为TMLE-DML-PPCI。这两种估计量的渐近方差均符合我们推导出的效率界限。在估计量的构建过...。研究方法：回归分析、机器学习、因果推断。

papers.title: GOALS OF INNOVATIVE PLANT GROWING ECOSYSTEM MANAGEMENT
papers.abstract:
The development of innovative plant breeding is facing new challenges in the modern world. The progress of this sector is interconnected not only with the opportunities for introducing innovations, but also with legislative support, behavioral attitudes of farmers, and the organization of business according to ESG principles, which are collectively presented as an innovative plant breeding ecosystem. 
The research makes suggestions on how to make the efficiency of the innovative plant breeding ecosystem measurable and with what methodology to manage it in competitive agrobusiness conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】在现代社会中，创新植物育种的发展正面临新的挑战。该领域的进展不仅与引入创新的机会密切相关，还与立法支持、农民的行为态度以及企业按照ESG（环境、社会和治理）原则进行组织的方式息息相关。这些因素共同构成了一个创新植物育种生态系统。  
本研究提出了如何使这一创新植物育种生态系统的效率得以量化，以及在竞争激烈的农业商业环境中应采用何种方法来管理该生态系统的建议。。

papers.title: Alternative Data for Realised Volatility Forecasting: Limit Order Book and News Stories
papers.abstract: We examine whether two major alternative data sources, limit order book information and firm‐specific news, provide incremental predictive information for daily realised volatility forecasting within the HAR‐family, using a parsimonious framework to ensure practical implementation and comparability. The framework is designed for practical real‐time forecasting, requiring minimal changes to the benchmark specification and no auxiliary models. Relative to a strong benchmark, both sources contain incremental predictive information, although the gains are more consistent for firm‐specific news, which emerges as the most reliable signal. The news volume measure delivers the most robust improvements overall, while sentiment‐based measures provide less consistent gains, indicating that news arrival matters more than news tone; within the order book, depth measures contribute more to forecasting performance than slope measures. Predictive gains are strongest on high volatility days, and a trade‐off between performance on normal and high volatility days is evident across signals.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们研究了两种主要的替代数据来源——限价单簿信息和公司特定新闻——是否能为HAR家族模型中的日实现波动率预测提供额外的预测信息。为此，我们采用了简约的框架以确保模型的实际可行性和可比性。该框架专为实时预测而设计，对基准模型的修改最小化，且无需额外的辅助模型。与强大的基准模型相比，这两种数据来源均能提供额外的预测信息，其中公司特定新闻的预测效果更为稳定，被认为是最可靠的信号。在各种指标中，新闻量指标带来的预测改进最为显著；而基于情绪的指标则表现出较低的预测稳定性，这表明新闻的发布时间比新闻的基调更为重要。在限价单簿数据中，深度指标对预测性能的贡献大于斜率指标。在高波动率交易日，预测效果的提升最为明显；同时，不同信号在正常波动率交易日和高波动率交易日之间的预测性能也存在明显的差异。。

papers.title: Non-Spanning Identification of Scheduled Event Risk in Option Pricing
papers.abstract: Short-dated index options make scheduled macro-announcement risk visible in market prices, but identification is nontrivial: a flexible no-event surface fitted to event-spanning quotes can absorb event premia, while a jump calibrated without event-spanning quotes is unidentified. We therefore model Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) decisions, Consumer Price Index (CPI) releases, and nonfarm payroll (NFP) reports as deterministic-time jumps in risk-neutral option pricing and propose a non-spanning identification protocol. Non-spanning expiries identify the no-event volatility surface, event-spanning training quotes calibrate the scheduled jump, and held-out event-spanning quotes are used only for pricing evaluation. On PM-settled S\&P 500 index (SPX) options from May 2022 to August 2025, Gaussian and two-component mixture jumps improve held-out event-spanning pricing, with the clearest gains in robust median pricing errors and in event-volatility option combinations (straddles and strangles) rather than directional risk reversals. A contaminated-surface stress test confirms the identification concern: allowing event-spanning training quotes into the no-event surface fit produces strong held-out performance by absorbing event premia rather than identifying scheduled jump risk. An amortized mixture density network (MDN) benchmark shows limited cross-event transfer: pure leave-one-event-out amortization reduces implied-volatility errors but not mean dollar or mean spread-normalized pricing errors, while the scale-calibrated variant restores Gaussian-level performance yet remains below event-specific mixture calibration. Scheduled-jump identification is strongest for CPI and FOMC and weaker for NFP.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】短期指数期权使得宏观政策公告的不确定性通过市场价格得以体现，但这种不确定性的识别并非易事：一种能够灵活适应不同事件持续时间报价的“无事件波动率曲面”模型能够有效吸收与事件相关的溢价；而另一种不依赖事件持续时间报价进行校准的模型则无法准确识别这种风险。因此，我们将联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）的决策、消费者价格指数（CPI）的发布以及非农就业数据（NFP）的报告视为风险中性期权定价中的确定性时间跳跃，并提出了一种新的识别方法。该方法通过非事件持续时间的期权到期日来确定“无事件波动率曲面”，利用事件持续时间的训练报价来校准预期的价格跳跃，而将那些未包含在训练数据中的事件持续时间报价仅用于定价评估。通过对2022年5月至2025年8月期间以现金结算的标普500指数（SPX）期权数据进行实证分析，我们发现高斯分布模型及双组分混合分布模型在改善未包含在训练数据中的事件持续时间报价的定价效果方面表现优异，尤其是在降低波动率中位数估计的误差以及构建事件相关期权组合（如跨式期权和勒式期权）时效果最为显著。此外，通过“污染波动率曲面”的压力测试进一步证实了识别难度：将事件持续时间报价纳入“无事件波...。

papers.title: (Human) Attention Is (Still) All You Need: Human oversight makes AI-assisted social science reliable
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for tasks once reserved for trained researchers, including hypothesis generation, specification choice, and drafting conclusions. We argue that the reliability of AI-assisted research depends not only on model capability, but also on how cognitive labour is structured between humans and machines. We study this problem through Human-in-the-Loop Economic Research (HLER), a decision architecture based on pre-commitment, decision sequencing, accountability, and attention allocation. In a pre-specified 2*4 factorial experiment with 280 complete research runs across four datasets, an unconstrained multi-agent baseline produced critical failures in 72% of runs. Using the same underlying model, the same agent decomposition, and identical prompts for the shared reasoning agents, HLER reduced the failure rate to 16% by imposing three architectural commitments: LLMs reason but do not execute data work, data and estimation are handled deterministically, and three human decision gates bind the workflow. Fisher's exact test rejects equality of failure rates at p<0.001. Reliability gains were largest on the least publicly represented dataset, a Qing-dynasty population register, consistent with a task-based production model with Frechet-distributed output quality. An 80-run ablation suggests that deterministic computation and human gates contribute independently, with exploratory evidence of complementarity. We interpret HLER as a research harness rather than an autonomous AI scientist: it sharply reduces failures, makes residual weaknesses more visible, and prevents unreliable claims from being advanced as publication-ready outputs.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于那些曾经仅限于受过专业训练的研究人员才能完成的任务，包括假设生成、方案选择以及结论撰写等。我们认为，人工智能辅助研究的可靠性不仅取决于模型的能力，还取决于人类与机器之间在认知劳动方面的分工方式。我们通过“人在循环中的经济研究”（Human-in-the-Loop Economic Research，简称HLER）这一研究框架来探讨这一问题。该框架基于预先设定的承诺机制、决策顺序、责任划分以及注意力分配等原则来指导研究过程。在一项包含280次完整研究实验的2×4因子实验中（数据集涵盖四个不同领域），未采用任何约束机制的多智能体研究方案在72%的实验中出现了严重错误。通过引入三项关键架构约束，我们使用相同的模型、相同的智能体分工以及相同的提示信息，将错误率降低到了16%：LLMs仅负责进行推理工作而不执行数据处理任务；数据与估算过程由人类来决定性地完成；同时，三个由人类控制的决策节点对整个研究流程进行协调。费希尔精确检验（Fisher’s exact test）的结果表明，这两种方法在降低错误率方面的效果具有显著性差异（p<0.001）。其中，...。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: To Share or Not to Share: Orchestrating Trustworthy Data in Global Value Chains
papers.abstract: As the EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) approaches, the global semiconductor value chain faces growing structural tensions between regulatory transparency and data sovereignty. This article proposes a RegTech reference architecture using the International Data Spaces (IDSA) framework to orchestrate trustworthy environmental telemetry across the semiconductor-petrochemical nexus. The framework distinguishes the mandatory CBAM requirements from voluntary Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) frameworks, while addressing the additive complexities of the Safe-and-Sustainable-by-Design (SSbD) framework. Moving beyond standard linear technology stacks, we introduce a prospective roadmapping methodology that transforms upstream physical vulnerabilities into circular, negative feedback loops. Focusing on the Taipei and Penang technology corridor, the article details how sovereign data exchange enables Digital Product Passports (DPPs) to drive Global Business Services (GBSs) capability demands. Finally, we discuss the integration of Agentic AI for autonomous compliance and FinTech green financing, providing a scalable blueprint for global industrial clusters to achieve sovereign, sustainable, and transparent value chains.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】随着欧盟碳边境调整机制（CBAM）的临近，全球半导体价值链在监管透明性与数据主权之间面临着日益加剧的结构性矛盾。本文提出了一种基于国际数据空间（IDSA）框架的RegTech参考架构，旨在协调半导体与石化产业之间的环境数据传输与共享。该框架明确了CBAM的强制性要求与自愿性“基于科学的减排目标”（SBTi）倡议之间的区别，并妥善处理了“安全与可持续设计”（SSbD）框架所带来的额外复杂性。我们超越了传统的线性技术架构，提出了一种前瞻性的路线图方法，将上游产业中的物理脆弱性转化为循环型、负反馈式的运营模式。以台北和槟城技术走廊为例，文章详细阐述了数据主权如何推动数字产品护照（DPP）的发展，进而满足全球商业服务（GBS）的需求。最后，我们探讨了如何整合人工智能技术以实现自主合规，并结合金融科技推动绿色融资，为全球产业集群构建一个可扩展的蓝图，以实现主权、可持续且透明的价值链。。

papers.title: Orchestrating the Twin Transition in Multinational Corporations: Technology Roadmapping for Green and Digital Global Business Services
papers.abstract: Global Business Services (GBS) have emerged as a "living laboratory" for the Twin Transition of Green and Digital Transformation, as multinational corporations (MNCs) face increasing pressure to harmonize digital efficiency with environmental stewardship. Aiming to derive a socio-technical framework, this paper synthesizes Technology Roadmapping (TRM) with the International Telecommunication Union (ITU) ICT-centric innovation ecosystem toolkit. A bibliometric analysis of research clusters reveals an evolutionary shift from basic process automation toward "Sustainable Intelligence," identifying the GBS unit as a central "operational airlock" that mediates between landscape pressures -- such as the EU's dual mandate and Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanisms -- and niche innovations in AI-native workflows. The study further maps these clusters onto a stakeholder engagement canvas, highlighting how resilient "Middle Power" hubs in Poland, Portugal, and Malaysia are bypassing the middle-income trap to provide a "third way" for global value chains amidst a bifurcated geopolitical cloud. The results offer a data-driven design approach for leaders and entrepreneurial support networks to orchestrate talent and supply chain flows, thereby enriching the conceptual understanding of Industry 5.0 and the role of GBS as a primary mechanism for navigating a volatile, multipolar digital economy.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】全球商业服务（GBS）已成为绿色转型与数字化转型这一双重变革进程的“实验场”。跨国公司（MNCs）面临着日益增长的压力，需要将数字化效率与环境责任相结合。本文旨在构建一个社会技术框架，将技术路线图（TRM）与国际电信联盟（ITU）提出的以信息通信技术（ICT）为核心的创新生态系统工具箱相结合。通过对研究领域的文献计量分析，研究发现其发展重心已从基础流程自动化转向“可持续智能”（Sustainable Intelligence）。全球商业服务被视为一个关键的“操作枢纽”，在欧盟的双重监管要求、碳边境调节机制等外部压力与基于人工智能的创新工作流程之间起到桥梁作用。研究还将这些创新集群映射到利益相关者参与框架中，指出波兰、葡萄牙和马来西亚等“中等强国”正成功突破中等收入陷阱，为处于地缘政治分裂环境中的全球价值链提供了新的发展路径。研究结果为领导者及创业支持网络提供了一种数据驱动的设计方法，帮助他们协调人才与供应链的流动，从而深化了对工业4.0（Industry 4.0）的理解，并进一步明确了全球商业服务在引领动荡多极化数字经济中的核心作用。。

papers.title: Estimating Semiparametric and Nonparametric Fixed Effects Panel Data Models with mgcv
papers.abstract: This paper provides a practical guide to estimating semiparametric and nonparametric fixed-effects panel data models using the mgcv package in R. The focus is implementation: handling fixed effects with unit indicators, first differencing, or penalized unit effects; specifying smooth terms; and conducting cluster-robust inference. Monte Carlo experiments compare \code{mgcv::bam} estimators with linear and fixed-series spline estimators. Simulations suggest that penalized splines adapt to unknown smoothness and estimate functions accurately in the designs studied here. A penalty-adjusted cluster-robust covariance estimator yields tests with near-nominal size for finite-dimensional parameters, and confidence bands provide accurate coverage for centered unknown functions.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文提供了使用R语言中的mgcv包估计半参数和非参数固定效应面板数据模型的实用指南。重点在于实际操作：如何处理带有单位指示变量、进行一阶差分处理或采用惩罚机制的固定效应；如何指定平滑项；以及如何进行群组鲁棒性推断。通过蒙特卡洛实验，将mgcv::bam估计量与线性估计量及固定序列样条估计量进行了比较。模拟结果表明，在所研究的设计中，惩罚样条方法能够适应未知的平滑度，并准确估计函数值。经过惩罚调整的群组鲁棒协方差估计量能够为有限维参数生成接近名义水平的检验统计量；而置信带则能够为居中的未知函数提供准确的覆盖范围。。研究方法：面板数据、实验方法、蒙特卡洛模拟、固定效应、数值模拟。

papers.title: In-Family Arbitrage-Free Interpolation of Mixture Densities Across Expirations
papers.abstract: Given risk-neutral densities of a tradeable forward, fitted as $N$-component mixtures at a finite set of expiration pillars, we look for a continuous-time interpolation that (i) stays inside the mixture family (it remains a mixture of the same kernel, though generically with more components than either pillar), and (ii) is the marginal flow of a Markov martingale, equivalently carries a non-negative Dupire local volatility. The second requirement is the peacock (convex-order) property. For full-support kernels (Gaussian, lognormal) a peacock corresponds to a unique continuous local-volatility diffusion (Lowther). We give a constructive interpolation that stays in a fixed $2N$-component family, note as an open question whether $N$ components suffice, and describe the main practical difficulty: in strongly bimodal regimes the local volatility stays finite but becomes badly conditioned.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在给定风险中性密度的可交易远期合约的情况下，这些密度被拟合为有限个到期时间点上的$N$组分混合分布。我们寻求一种连续时间插值方法，该方法需满足以下条件：（i）仍属于该混合分布族（即仍然是相同核函数的混合分布，尽管通常组分数量会超过任一到期时间点上的组分数量）；（ii）作为马尔可夫鞅的边际流动过程，等价于具有非负的Dupire局部波动率。第二个要求体现了所谓的“孔雀”（凸序）性质。对于具有完全支撑集的核函数（如高斯分布、对数正态分布），这种“孔雀”性质对应于一个唯一的连续局部波动率扩散过程（Lowther过程）。我们提出了一种构造性的插值方法，该方法能够保持在一个固定的$2N$组分混合分布族中，并指出$N$个组分是否足够实现这一目标仍是一个未解决的问题。同时，我们也指出了实际应用中的主要难点：在高度双峰分布的情况下，局部波动率虽然保持有限，但其条件性质会变得非常复杂（即计算难度显著增加）。。
